BUILDPLAN.md T-13 (M2).

`a11y`: keyboard, live regions per phase and the private hint, AA contrast, 44 px, reduced motion, over every surface and phase

Criteria: AC-82–86
Harness hooks: see EVALUATION.md rows for those IDs; `just test` is the inner loop (≤ 60 s).
Depends on (BUILDPLAN): T-05–07
BUILDPLAN notes: Serialized on `justfile` (`a11y`)

Workflow mode: fast-track. Terminal pre-merge status: review. PR base: origin/main.
Standing clauses: criteria outrank SPEC on behaviour, state, payloads and copy; SPEC outranks the prototype, which wins on visual detail only. Never write down what a program prints. Answer position is a uniform draw from the date, never balanced. Miri proves absence of UB on executed paths only. Colour is never the only signal. Code never causes horizontal page scroll. Never `git add -A`. Signing goes through 1Password: retry once, then escalate.

Plan: filled in by the delegator's plan phase.

data.body: DISPATCHED PQ-16 2026-09-29 23:4x EDT by the Orchestrator: fast-track, surface:12 in pane:1, worktree /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz-worktrees/a11y-sweep, branch ai-c11-cc/a11y-sweep off origin/main @ 1263add270aafbb5cc087c3e7c94981c5f17c9fd. Boot prompt at the worktree's .claude/boot-prompt.md (templates/gen-wave17.py). Rulings in the brief: (1) AC-84's dim-room clause has no built presentation (lights up, no dark mode in v1, touchpoint T-16; F-37 routed upstream) - prove AA on the one presentation and record the clause under deviations, build no dim mode; (2) just a11y is a node suite on the existing runner with no dependency, run from test-full per EVALUATION and from test too if hermetic and fast; PENDING drops a11y:T-13 (the PQ-20 shape); what a layout-less stub cannot prove is a once-by-hand c11 browser pass written into web/README.md for the validator; (3) no new copy - a state change in AC-83's list with no SPEC section 11 string is a QUESTION on this ticket, never a string; (4) web/shared/tokens.css, components.css and dom.js are cleared additively, a colour token value change needs a ruling by comment first; room/** is read-only. No sibling this wave; PQ-26 and PQ-27 press ahead off your branch once you are at review, so keep the justfile change to the a11y lines. Push and gh pr create are the client's Yes in your tab.
READY PQ-16 CWD /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz-worktrees/a11y-sweep HEAD 1263add270aafbb5cc087c3e7c94981c5f17c9fd BASE 1263add270aafbb5cc087c3e7c94981c5f17c9fd MODE active

ORCHESTRATOR on your plan (read 23:5x): D1 as ruled. D2 accepted - the criterion outranks the prototype on colour; because the wall is the loved design, attach BEFORE/AFTER screenshots (wall idle, live and reveal; the buzzer live and reveal; take-it-home) in your validation note so the client can see every colour shift and veto one if they choose; name each shifted element and its old/new ratio there. D3 accepted and recorded for the validator: the dimmed trace lines are the walk-through mechanism (DESIGN, AC-97/AC-99); print the ratio, mark the pair exempt, list it under deviations. D4 accepted (text alternative beside each bar). D5 accepted; keep the comment short. D6 accepted (AC-85's words are unscoped). D7: the trace buttons' accessible names are pre-existing literals outside section 11 - leave them; I route the missing rows upstream (F-38). Note for DONE: your suite lands in test via the test-web glob, so state the warm time of just test with it included and keep it under 60 s. No sibling; PQ-26/PQ-27 wait on your review.

DONE PQ-16 PR https://github.com/mrojas54/rust-nyc-pop-quiz/pull/37 HEAD b0dda3e57702f835be9818a469b799dc609f0024 BASE 1263add270aafbb5cc087c3e7c94981c5f17c9fd test-warm 12.7 deviations: (1) AC-84 dim-room clause: no built presentation (T-16, F-37); AA is proven on the lights-up presentation only. (2) Criterion over prototype on colour (D2, accepted). Focus ring, wall join link, well header/line numbers/comments, the ✓ letter and the wall chip, the trace-highlight edge, and the buzzer field edge all moved to AA values. Two NEW names in components.css (--focus-ring = amber-700, --success-text = #276749) are applied per surface; no token value changed. Before/after screenshots and old->new ratios are attached. (3) D3: dimmed trace lines (opacity .32, 1.84:1) are printed and marked exempt, not held. (4) D4: bar fills are supplementary (n · p% beside each). (5) D6: AC-85 is applied to take-it-home too (trace buttons 34 -> 44 px). (6) web/test/home.test.js: one regex loosened (<pre class="vv"> now carries tabindex). (7) The justfile's test-full summary echo still lists what ran before; I left it alone to keep the justfile change to the a11y lines. notes: the suite runs inside test through the test-web glob (warm just test 12.7 s, room+web in parallel; test-pipeline cannot start on this machine). Code review PASS-WITH-NITS at 8cb36e0, Minors fixed in 7f1c2a0. The browser pass ran in the c11 browser, where press sends synthetic keys that move no focus in WKWebView, so the real Tab walk, VoiceOver and the OS Reduce-motion toggle are web/README.md step 5, by hand, for the validator. Upstream suggestion: setting --border-focus to amber-700 would let the per-surface ring rules collapse into one. The PR's CI (just test, just test-full) was in progress at open. room/** untouched, copy.js untouched, no string authored.
